blurb: Prussian capital, divided city, and capital of Germany again since 1990.

go: The fall of the Berlin Wall
facts.t: On the night of 9 November 1989 a confused announcement led crowds to the border crossings, and the guards opened them. The Wall had divided the city for 28 years.

src.n: Wikipedia: Fall of the Berlin Wall

facts.t: Einstein worked in Berlin from 1914 and published general relativity here in 1915. When the Nazis took power in 1933 he was abroad, and he never came back.
Frederick the Great's summer palace Sanssouci, French for without a care, is in nearby Potsdam. Voltaire stayed with him there from 1750 to 1753, and they quarrelled.
